name: claude-mods
description: A collection of Claude Code mods by Alok Mehta

plugins.name: client-mask
plugins.description: Mask client names, personal data and secrets before anything leaves this machine; keep the list private and leave no trace of what was swapped

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context fill as a bar above the prompt, with prompt-cache hit rate and whether the cache is still warm

plugins.name: control-panel
plugins.description: Click instead of remembering: a panel of each project's own commands and playbooks, what needs you now, a wiki desk for reading proposals and findings, and where you left off. It never changes how your agents work.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Keep Claude out of your git history: no co-author trailer, no PR footer, and no push of a commit that carries one

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Hold documents Claude writes to your house style: no dashes, British spelling, none of your banned words. It enforces the author's own style: see the note below the table.

plugins.name: released-objects
plugins.description: Flag SAP objects in ABAP code that are not released, deprecated or have no API, with SAP's successor, using SAP's own release lists. It flags, never blocks.

plugins.name: workspace-board
plugins.description: One board for what is waiting on you across your projects: sessions waiting for an answer or approval, proposals to review, blockers, action items and handoffs, each with a button to jump there or start it. Opened from the Board button on the context bar.
